shortDescription: Psycasts² — Diablo 2-style psycast skill levels, auto synergies (toggleable off), optional fog-of-war tree, a resizable PoE constellation spec tree, seven ascension constellations, meditation→awakening→3-tier enlightenment (pilgrimage completion now reforms a caravan home), enemy psycaster tiers, an XML awakening trigger API, TieringOverrideDef + BalanceOverrideDef handoffs, JSON balance export/import, optional hardcore reset-lockout, full keyed localization, and celebration FX.
body:
(spec excerpt - flat level cap, ISEKAI compat, psylink gate + random-Awakened spawn)

## Testing preference (standing)
ALWAYS launch with companion Modern Psycasts UI (`astryl.ModernPsycastsUI`). For FULL addon coverage also load every installed 1.6 VPE addon: dev.tobot.vpe.betterautocast, Aranmaho.Makai.Psycast, Waffle.FantasyPatches, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Hemosage, Danzen.VPE.BiotechIntegration, Aranmaho.RavenousEye.Wildhunter.Psycast, VPE.Horaxian.Sentinel, Aranmaho.RangerClass, mute.vpesensitivity, VPE.Aeromancer.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAeromancer, VPE.Anima.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAnima, VPE.Arknights.Sentinel, VPE.Blader.Sentinel, VPE.Bugmancer.Sentinel, VPE.Framework.Sentinel, VPE.Deadlife.Sentinel, VPE.Geomancer.Sentinel, VPE.Gravcaster.Sentinel, VPE.Hydromancer.Sentinel, VPE.Luminis.Sentinel, VPE.Mechanitor.Sentinel, VPE.Neurophage.Sentinel, VPE.Oripathy.Sentinel, VPE.PhaseShift.Sentinel, VPE.Umbra.Sentinel, VPE.Veincaster.Sentinel, VPE.Voidweaver.Sentinel, morton.VPEAddOnPsycastCardRetextures, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Puppeteer. EXCLUDED: VPE.Gauranlen.Sentinel (declares missing dep vanillaexpanded.ideo.dryads -> spams VDE_AwakenedDryad PawnKindDef + dryad texture errors; re-add only if the Dryads mod gets installed), VPE.BiotechIntegration.Adendum (missing dep), gwibbo.morepsygenes + Sl4vP0weR.NoPsycasts (not 1.6), VPersonaWeaponsE (not a psycast addon). Palette pins (tools take "T: " prefix; category is NOT a path segment): "Actions\T: Force awakening (Tier I)", "Actions\T: Grant psycaster level (+1)", "Actions\T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)"; incidents pin as "Actions\Do incident\PS_Awakening" / "Actions\Do incident\PS_AwakeningSurgeIncident". Known-unrelated noise: VPE .dds Texture2D load errors (e.g. PathBG_Archon.dds from workshop 2842502659); stale palette pins from other sessions. cs-assets.json drift warnings for UI/Specs/* etc. are concatenation false positives; keep them. NOTE: isolated test sessions keep their OWN mod-settings config (test-savedata/Config/Mod_*.xml) — in-game tuning edits live there, but the Bake button writes ManualBalance.json into the mod folder itself, which persists.

## Fog of war, synergy on/off, hardcore reset-lockout, resizable constellation, pilgrimage caravan-reform, modpack balance import (2026-07-13)
- **Fog of war** (`fogOfWar`, default OFF; Skills tab). Hides un-learned psycast identities behind a dark "?" cover on the tree until unlocked. One Repaint-only block in `Patch_DrawAbility.Postfix` (paints over `inRect` + "?" glyph, box border) — NO ButtonInvisible, so VPE's click-to-unlock passes through; cover vanishes the frame the pawn learns it. Tooltip reveal suppressed via `SkillTooltip.NotifyFogHover(rect)` (sets suppressRect like NotifyHover so `Patch_SuppressVpeAbilityTip` kills VPE's tip, but `ability=null` so our card bails). Tree layout/connector lines stay visible.
- **Disable synergies/empowers** (`disableSynergies`, default OFF; Skills tab, above the synergy-% slider which hides when disabled). `SkillSystem.StatMultiplier` skips the synergy source loop (own-level scaling + specs still apply); `SkillTooltip.Build` skips received/empowers (Model.synergiesOff → Draw/Measure skip those sections); `Patch_DrawAbility` hover-pulse guarded by `synergiesOn`. TabSpec Synergy-graph header shows an amber `PS_SetSynDisabledNote` when off.
- **Hardcore reset-lockout** (`disableSkillReset`, `disableSpecReset`, both default OFF). `disableSkillReset` hides the psycast tab's "Reset skills" button (Patch_PsycastTabRespec; when hidden, the "Reset path" tier-surrender button spans the full row). `disableSpecReset` hides the constellation window's player "Reset specializations" refund button (Window_Specializations respecRow/RespecTex). Dev reset buttons unaffected. Settings: `PS_SetNoSkillReset` (Skills tab) + `PS_SetNoSpecReset` (Specializations tab).
- **Resizable constellation window** — Window_Specializations now sets `resizeable = true` in the ctor (was `resizeable = editMode` only in dev); drag the bottom-right corner. `resizer` is PRIVATE in Verse.Window so min-size can't be customized from the subclass (default WindowResizer min is 150×150; acceptable). Layout is inRect-relative so it adapts to any size.
- **Pilgrimage completion reforms a caravan (BUG2 fix)** — `QuestPart_PilgrimMeditation.FireSuccess` / `QuestPart_PilgrimJourney.FireSuccess` no longer `site.Destroy()` on completion (that tore down the map with the pilgrim on it → lost pawn). Instead: keep the site the pilgrim is standing on, refresh its TimeoutComp to 15 days, and send `PS_MsgPilgrimReform` telling the player to reform a caravan. Vanilla `Site` already ships `WorldObjectCompProperties_FormCaravan` (reform gizmo) and `Site.ShouldRemoveMapNow` auto-removes the map+world-object once the caravan leaves. Journey uses `DestroyAllSitesExcept(keep)` (keep = pilgrim's current site); other already-vacated sites are cleaned. FireFail also spares a site the pilgrim is still standing on.
- **Modpack-creator balance edits** — (A) `BalanceOverrideDef` (Source/BalanceOverride.cs): mod-facing custom Def (mirrors TieringOverrideDef) a pack author ships in THEIR mod's Defs (`<primaries>`/`<empowers>`/`<sources>`; `<stat>` = SynStat name/"none"/int; fields optional). `ManualBalance.ApplyOverrideDefs()` folds them into the overlay dicts at the END of `Load()` (runs even with no ManualBalance.json), ABOVE baked JSON, UNDER PlayerTuning; last def wins. (B) In-game "Import balance edits (from JSON)" button (Specializations tab, public, `PS_SetImport`) → `ManualBalance.ListImportableFiles()` lists `*.json` in `<SaveData>/Psycasts2/` (newest first) as a FloatMenu → `ManualBalance.ImportPlayerTuning(path)` parses leaf `{…}` objects (tolerant of grouped Share export statId+name AND flat k/stat-int; kind inferred by fields) into PlayerTuning. Wiki: xml-triggers.html section 9.

## Known open items (2026-07-13, awaiting user clarification)
- **Settings "Skills tab disappears" on an errant click** — reported but cause not yet identified. Ruled out: my conditional synergy-% slider (RimWorld's Widgets.HorizontalSlider is a custom impl, no Unity control-ID → no Layout/Repaint control-count exception; bools only flip on MouseUp so Layout/Repaint stay consistent). Need: which click, and whether the SETTINGS Skills tab content blanks vs. the in-game psycast Skills tab.
- **BUG1 Hemosage blocked for Sanguophages** — VPE's `AbilityExtension_HemogenRequirement.IsEnabledForPawn` needs a `Gene_Hemogen` gene AND hemogen resource > 0.1 (a Sanguophage HAS the gene, so blockage is either hemogen-too-low = WAI, or a learn-gate we haven't found). Path `VPEH_Hemosage` has `<requiredGene>Hemogenic</requiredGene>` + `ensureLockRequirement=True`; our `disableGeneRequirements` (default ON) strips requiredGene + lockedReason at startup. Need the exact "blocked" symptom (hover reason text / can't-learn vs can't-cast) to fix.

## Celebration FX for level-ups, mastery, mastered trees, and spec commits (SkillFx.cs, 2026-07-10)
Modeled on the Window_Awakening card-reveal burst (glow flash + expanding ring + golden-ratio spark spray; reuses UI/Sparkle + UI/Glow + UI/Specs/node_ring). Static registry keyed by pawn+ability ("id:defName") or pawn+spec ("spec:id:specId"); draw sites poll SkillFx.Draw(rect, key) per repaint; bursts self-remove; Trigger sweeps entries older than 5s. Spark sizes scale with rect (clamped 0.4-1.3).
**Grades:** Invest (0.55s) on every player level invest; Mastery (1.4s, lingering gold border, at-cap gold) when the invest reaches the ABSOLUTE cap = maxSkillLevel + SpecEffects.LevelCapBonus (10/15); SpecNode per committed spec node; SpecCapstone for Specs.IsCapstone ids. ROUND grades draw NO rectangular boxes (node_ring texture). **NO BOXES IN THE CONSTELLATION, EVER** (user directive): DrawNode's capstone frame is a layered gold RING halo (NodeRingTex).
**Mastered trees (Patch_TreeMastered.cs):** a tree card whose EVERY path ability is learned AND at the absolute cap gets a persistent pulsing gold card glow + ambient sparkle flecks. Hook is ONE postfix on PsycastsUIUtility.DoPathAbilities — the shared render path BOTH VPE's native tab and Modern UI's DrawTreeTile call.
**Verification dev tool:** "T: Max all psycast skills (absolute cap)" (MeditationSystem.cs) sets every learned psycast to absCap via gc.SetLevel — makes the tree glow testable in one click.
**Setting:** skillFx (default ON, Skill leveling section). OFF = no visuals, no extra sounds, legacy Tick_High restored; mastery message still sends.

## Localization (full keyed translation layer)
Languages/English/Keyed/ holds 4 files (~495 keys), ALL user-facing C# strings route through .Translate(): **PS_Lore.xml** (tier names, letters/messages incl. PS_MsgPilgrimReform + PS_ThePilgrim, card window strings, pilgrim inspect strings, ascension readout), **PS_UI.xml** (dialogs, tab tool block, skill tooltip incl. PS_Stat_*/composition templates/PS_Fx*/PS_Branch_*, PS_MsgSkillMastered), **PS_Settings.xml** (5 PS_SetTab_* + every settings header/label/tooltip incl. PS_SetFogOfWar, PS_SetDisableSynergies, PS_SetSynDisabledNote, PS_SetNoSkillReset, PS_SetNoSpecReset, PS_SetImport/Title/Body + PS_MsgImportFailed/NoImportFiles + PS_Ovr_* + share/bake/discard), **PS_Specs.xml** (GENERATED from Specs.cs by regex). **Mechanics:** Spec ctor + Specs.BranchLabel resolve via Specs.TranslateOr(key, fallback). Everything else uses plain "PS_Key".Translate(args) — a missing key SHOWS as diacritic gibberish, re-run the audit after adding strings. EXCLUDED (intentional): dev tools (Window_BalanceEditor, debug actions), generated HTML reports, Log.* lines. **Edit user-facing strings in the XML, not in code.**

## Open-beta balance feedback: Share JSON export + Import
Mod settings -> Specializations tab -> "Balance edits (open beta)": PUBLIC buttons = **Share** (`ManualBalance.ExportPlayerTuning`: writes live PlayerTuning to `<SaveData>/Psycasts2/BalanceIdeas_<ts>.json`, grouped per tree; path copied to clipboard) + **Import** (see modpack section) + **Discard**. DEV-MODE = **Bake** into `<modRoot>/ManualBalance.json` (merges overlay over baked records, player wins, clears overlay). GOTCHA: GenFilePaths.FolderUnderSaveData is PRIVATE in 1.6 — use GenFilePaths.SaveDataFolderPath + Directory.CreateDirectory.

## No trait system
The enlightenment tier is the PS_Enlightenment hediff (Severity = tier, brain-seated). There is NO enlightenment trait - SetTier/TierOf are 100% hediff-based; Traits.xml is empty.

## Psycaster level cap is FLAT (default 400), tier-independent
vpeLevelCap default 400 (slider 30-500), overrideVpeLevelCap default true -> ApplyVpeLevelCap writes VPE maxLevel. Patch_LevelCap.EffectiveMax = BaseMax() (no tier). Migration balanceVersion 4->5.

## Psylink gate + random Awakened spawn (Patch_EnemyTiers, GenerateNewPawnInternal, Priority.Last)
Postfix: TryInjectTier (hostile psycaster -> chance enemyTierFreq of a tier upgrade), then GatePsylink (when `gateUntieredPsylinks`, default ON): skip Awakened+/PS_AncientPsycasters; eligible humanlikes (13+) roll awakenedSpawnChance (0.05) to spawn as fresh Awakened; otherwise generated psylinks are stripped. `noAwakenedStartingPawns` (default ON) exempts PlayerStarter pawns from the random roll. All gates respect TieringControl.

## XML Awakening Trigger API (AwakeningTrigger.cs + AwakeningSurfaces.cs + Defs/AwakeningTriggers.xml)
One shared `AwakeningTriggerExtension` DefModExtension + one funnel `AwakeningTrigger.Fire(pawn, ext, source)` (public overload Fire(pawn, tier, silent) for C# mods). **7 surfaces:** HediffComp, CompUseEffect (artifacts), IncidentWorker (PS_Awakening), GameCondition surge (PS_AwakeningSurge), ThoughtDef, PreceptDef, QuestNode/QuestPart. Hooks: MeditationSystem.Tick calls HourlyScan every 2500 ticks. Docs: docs/wiki/xml-triggers.html.

## TieringOverrideDef — mod-facing ladder handoff (TieringOverride.cs)
Custom def `<PsycastSynergies.TieringOverrideDef>`: disable flags (umbrella `disableBuiltInTiering`) + reskin (tierNames/tierNameBeyondFormat/tierSpecPoints). **TieringControl** static aggregator. Trigger API deliberately ignores all disables. Wiki: section 8 on xml-triggers.html.

## ISEKAI RPG compat
suppressIsekaiPsycastStats (default ON): Patch_IsekaiSuppress strips IsekaiLeveling.* StatParts from psycaster stats at startup when JellyCreative.IsekaiLeveling is active.

## Awakening cards: manual flips, configurable deal, no-Esc + Choose later
`cardRevealAll` (default off): remaining cards turned BY HAND, any revealed card re-pickable. `cardPickCount` (0=auto 3/5, 1-8 fixed). Window_Awakening `closeOnCancel=false`; only "Choose later" sets the pick aside → `med.pendingPick` (scribed) + `Alert_PendingCardPick` (clicking re-opens).

## In-game synergy balance editor
**Access:** psycast tab, dev mode ON -> "Balance editor (dev)" (Patch_PsycastTabRespec). Window_BalanceEditor: THREE panes. Dev-only (not keyed). **Layering (PsycastInfo):** PlayerTuning > ManualBalance.json (baked) + BalanceOverrideDef (modpack XML, layered inside ManualBalance's dicts) > frozenSyn > computed.

## Psycast tab tool block + focus/path pickers
Per-pawn gizmos REMOVED; function moved into the psycast tab's bottom tool block (Patch_PsycastTabRespec), centered on the left pawn-info card. **Card-width anchoring:** `ModernUIBridge.LeftCardWidth(tabWidth)` = 340 when Wired else min(size.x*0.3, 340). **Focus picking via Modern Psycasts UI:** `ModernPsycastsUI.PawnFocusHooks` wired by reflection (ModernUIBridge.TryWire; no hard dependency).

## Text conventions
"Respec" BANNED (it's "Reset"); "&" BANNED (use "and"); em/en dashes BANNED; sentence case with proper nouns kept (tier names, Enlightenment, Awakening, Tier I/II/III, path/spec names, Trial of the Altar, Way of the Anima, Ancient Psycaster Order, Apotheosis, Dignified, quoted VPE button "Upgrade Psycaster Stats" — string-matched by Patch_AutoStatsPerLevel, do NOT change, Mech-Mind). ALL user-facing text lives in Languages/English/Keyed/.
